integrity: The vector field and both five-number lists were checked against the primary article's full PDF.
The proof is an exact determinant identity for the tangent flow and does not rely on numerical integration.
The bundled checker uses exact rational arithmetic for all source-parameter and printed-decimal comparisons.
scientific_limitations: The result invalidates the two printed full-spectrum vectors but does not independently decide whether the \(r=43\) trajectory is chaotic or whether the \(r=25\) trajectory converges.
The numerical implementation used for Figure 2 is not reconstructed, so the computational cause of the inconsistency is not identified.
The phase-volume identity is standard; the source-specific contradiction with the two published vectors is the new claim.
title: Exact phase-volume law contradicts both published Lyapunov spectra of a five-dimensional Lorenz model
